## What I do

Custom-coded websites — not templates, not Wix, not WordPress themes. Every site is written from scratch using modern frameworks (Astro, Next.js, React). Delivered live to a real domain in 14 days or fewer.

**I build:**
- Business websites (5–15 pages)
- School portals with admin panels
- E-commerce and D2C storefronts (custom Razorpay, not Shopify themes)
- Travel / booking platforms with WhatsApp-first funnels
- AI-powered products (built WebSeek.ai, an AI website generator)
- Landing pages for ad campaigns and product launches

**I do NOT build:**
- Template installs or Wix/WordPress builds
- Discovery-phase projects that take months before a pixel is drawn
- Web3 / crypto / metaverse
- Projects requiring 100% upfront with no refund policy
- Restaurants dependent on Zomato/Swiggy

## Services and pricing (INR, 2026)

All prices are published ranges. Final quote fixed on a 10-minute WhatsApp call.

| Package | Deliverable | Timeline | Price range |
|---|---|---|---|
| Landing | Single high-converting page | 5 days | ₹7,000–10,000 |
| Starter | 5-page business site | 14 days | ₹13,000–16,000 |
| Business | 10–15 pages + CMS/admin | 2–3 weeks | ₹28,000–32,000 |
| Premium | School portal / E-com / Brand | 3–5 weeks | ₹48,000–55,000 |
| Custom | Multi-vendor, SaaS, rescue | Quoted | On WhatsApp |
| AMC | Hosting + 2 hrs/mo updates | Monthly | ₹2,500/mo |

**Add-ons:**
- Logo design: ₹4,000 (included in Premium)
- Hindi-English bilingual: ₹3,000
- Other regional languages (Punjabi, Tamil, Marathi, etc.): ₹5,000 each
- Extra pages beyond package: ₹2,000/page
- Product photography: from ₹6,000
- Hero video edit: from ₹8,000

**Payment terms:** 50% advance to start → Day-5 design preview → refund if not approved → balance on delivery. UPI / NEFT / Razorpay. GST invoice on every project.

---

## Engagement model

1. **Brief (Day 1)** — 10–15 min WhatsApp or call. Scope confirmed, fixed quote sent.
2. **Advance** — 50% UPI/Razorpay. GST invoice issued. Work begins.
3. **Day-5 preview** — Live staging URL. Approve → continue. Don't approve → full refund, no questions.
4. **Build (Day 6–12)** — All pages built, forms wired to WhatsApp + email, mobile-tested.
5. **Launch (Day 13–14)** — Pointed to client domain. 5-min video walkthrough. 30 days free fixes.

## Live work (verified · Problem → Built → Outcome)

- **[WebSeek.ai](https://ai-website-generator-tan.vercel.app)** — AI website generator. Prompt → working site in <90 seconds. 3 model fallbacks (Claude · GPT · Gemini). Studio's own product. [Case study](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/webseek)
- **[InHimalayas](https://inhimalayas.vercel.app)** — Travel booking platform. Direct bookings bypassing OTA commissions. llms.txt + GEO-optimised from day one. AI-referred traffic lifted post-launch. [Case study](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/inhimalayas)
- **[Dharamshala Tours](https://dharamshalatours.in)** — WhatsApp-first tour operator CMS. ~1,000 bookings/month through custom funnel. [Case study](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/dharamshala-tours)
- **[Redline Moto](https://redlinestudios.in)** — Moto-apparel brand identity + Razorpay storefront. Single sprint. [Case study](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/redline)
- **[ChinkiZ Knitting Knife](https://chinkizknittingknife.com)** — D2C storefront for 600K-subscriber creator. Custom video gallery + UPI / cards / COD. [Case study](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/chinkiz)
- **[Modern K.B.S.](https://modernkbs.com)** — CBSE school site + admissions admin panel. Live in 7 days. Every other agency quoted 6 months. [Case study](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/modernkbs)
- **[Nandini Travels](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/nandini)** — Taxi operator rebuild. Direct bookings now live. "10× more premium than competitors." [Case study](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/nandini)
- **[North Peak Power Systems](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/northpeak)** — Solar contractor. 15-page site + project gallery + self-publish admin. Private-sector pivot complete. [Case study](https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/northpeak)

## Who this is right for

- Indian SMEs (clinics, salons, CAs, coaches, contractors, photographers) needing a credible web presence — ₹13K–32K budget
- Schools and coaching centres needing admissions portals with admin panels
- Travel operators and homestays needing direct-booking funnels that bypass aggregator commissions
- D2C brands (₹1Cr+ revenue) hitting the Shopify theme ceiling
- Content creators (100K+ following) wanting custom storefronts
- Startups at seed/Series A needing a credible marketing surface

---

## Machine-readable data notes

- **Structured data**: JSON-LD on every page (LocalBusiness + FAQ + HowTo + Person on homepage; Article + BreadcrumbList on blog posts; WebPage + BreadcrumbList on case studies; CollectionPage on blog index)
- **Canonical URLs**: Set on every page
- **Sitemap**: https://www.divyanshsood.com/sitemap.xml — updated with every deployment
- **OG tags**: Full og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url on every page
- **AI crawlers**: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended — all explicitly allowed in robots.txt
- **Contact action**: All contact forms submit to WhatsApp (wa.me), no third-party form backend
